jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: Build the Path Forward At Path Robotics , we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use. Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together. We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Robotics team. You'll use machine learning to improve how our robots plan, scan, and act. You'll frame real robot problems as well-defined ML problems, train models on data that a fleet of production robotic cells generates every day, and ship them into a production stack where they work alongside classical planning and perception. Your models run on live robots doing real work for customers. What You'll Do Frame open-ended problems in planning, scanning, and robot behavior as well-defined ML problems. Train models that work with classical methods, such as initial guesses and learned costs for trajectory optimization, plan quality and feasibility predictors, and learned collision models. Develop viewpoint planning policies that choose where and how to scan, and predict scan quality before the robot commits. Apply imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and generative models such as diffusion and flow matching where they outperform classical baselines. Build production ML pipelines: datasets from fleet logs and simulation, training, and metrics. Evaluate models in the loop, with offline metrics that predict gains on the robot, failure-mode analysis, and calibrated confidence that determines when the system falls back to classical methods. Own your models end to end, from prototype to deployment on live robotic cells, with low-latency inference and monitoring. Who

The Community You Will Join: Marketing Data Science Measurement empowers Airbnb to optimize marketing ROI through data-informed decision-making. We lead the way in defining and advancing best practices for measuring and optimizing marketing impact. We collaborate with Marketing, Finance, Engineering, and Product to provide actionable recommendations and tools based on effective, timely, and granular measurements. The Difference You Will Make As a Data Scientist working on algorithms on the Marketing Data Science team, you will develop the models and measurement behind Airbnbâs AI-driven marketing system where AI agents run campaigns within guardrails set by marketers. These systems shape how Airbnb acquires, retains, and re-engages its guest and host community across owned and paid channels. Your models will inform targeting, creative and spend across channels, audiences, and time. We are seeking a senior technical leader in ML-driven marketing systems to serve as the data science technical lead across these efforts. You will guide the measurement and optimization approaches for these systems, help develop the models that power them, set the scientific bar, and raise the capability of the team and our partners. Define with Marketing the objectives these systems optimize and the guardrails they operate within, so automated decisions on bids, budgets, audiences, content, and timing target incremental value rather than proxy metrics. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us. New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now. Two ways to work with clients Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it. Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process. Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own. What you get Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences. Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours. No micromanagement, no screen trackers Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries Who we’re looking for Senior Data Engineers with: 4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer Experience with Apache Airflow and Snowflake, or Python and SQL, is required Experience with AWS, GCP, or Microsoft Azure is mandatory You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue in the data or pipeline, design and build the solution, and ship it to production. You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster data processing, lower infrastructure costs, fresher data for stakeholders, fewer pipeline incidents). Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your technical decisions, raise risks early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls.
